description: Shared pHloat remote upload contract used by relay firmware, Google Apps Script, and Tilt Pi server.

auth.note: The shared upload secret authenticates every request. Because Google Apps Script web apps cannot read request headers, the token is delivered per-endpoint as described below. Comparisons are constant-time.
auth.google_apps_script: token field in the JSON body (POST) or ?token= query parameter (GET)

google_apps_script.notes: Deploy GoogleAppsScript.js as a web app (Execute as: Me, Anyone). Set PHLOAT_UPLOAD_SECRET in Script Properties. The relay includes "token" in the JSON body automatically.

tilt_pi.notes: Set upload_secret in config.json or PHLOAT_UPLOAD_SECRET env var. HTTP allowed on local network. Ignores the body "token" field.

payload.token: string (shared upload secret; consumed by Google Apps Script, ignored by Tilt Pi which uses the header)

response.tilt_matched: boolean (Tilt Pi and GAS when Tilt data found)
